source: GameFAQs (section 'GameCube USB Memory Adapter Save (North America)')
author: kirbygamelord
what_it_is: 100% complete save file. Absolutely everything is unlocked, including all characters, machines, courses, stadiums, music, alternate colors, and every checklist reward across Air Ride, Top Ride, and City Trial.

gamefaqs.section: GameCube USB Memory Adapter Save (North America)

format: GCI: the 64-byte card directory entry (GKYE01, file 'KA030621_0100_T030529_2154', 4 blocks, modified 2003-10-13 00:00:22, comment 'Kirby Air Ride / SAVE DATA 10/13/2003') then 4 x 8 KiB blocks = 32832 bytes

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/gc-gci.py place <file> <GC/USA/Card A>: copies the GCI unchanged into the GCI folder under Dolphin's own name for it

dolphin-emu.frontend: tools/retro-run, OpenGL 4.1 core context, options scripts/gc/dolphin-single-core.opt (CPU thread off, OSD off); save in <savedir>/User/GC/USA/Card A/ (the core's GCI folder)
dolphin-emu.detail: Air Ride > Records > Checklist: all 120 boxes filled, counter 120/120 (as described: 100% complete); baseline (no save): 'There is no Kirby Air Ride data ... Make a new save data file?' (libretro) / created a new file silently (Dolphin.app); the script then ends on the Air Ride menu

dolphin-emu@dolphin.frontend: Dolphin.app, isolated user folder (-u), batch mode (-b), input from a TAS movie (-m) made with work/standalone/tools/gen_dtm.py, frame dump; save in <user>/GC/USA/Card A/ (GCI folder)
dolphin-emu@dolphin.detail: Air Ride > Records > Checklist: all 120 boxes filled, counter 120/120 (as described: 100% complete); baseline (no save): 'There is no Kirby Air Ride data ... Make a new save data file?' (libretro) / created a new file silently (Dolphin.app); the script then ends on the Air Ride menu

note: Kirby Air Ride rewrites its file on the way to the checklist (both cores): new modified time, first block 5 on Dolphin's virtual card, about ten payload bytes; the filed file is the download.
